verdict.rationale: Square documents a first-party Subscriptions API (only its title appears in the evidence) and the ability to save recurring payment methods, so recurring billing exists as an owned capability. Nothing in the evidence shows plans, trials, upgrades or proration. An old community question about whether Square handles subscriptions is not a concrete contradiction. Missing for 10: documented subscription plans/variations, free trial periods, plan upgrade/downgrade flows, proration behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.
